technical.summary: NEE shows solid uptrend structure with price above all key MAs and bullish technicals, but negative MACD histogram and weak CMF signal incomplete accumulation; moderate swing entry with pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: NEE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 51 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed with only junior-level small purchases and one partial sale, offering minimal conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (297), strong dollar pressures utilities with international exposure, and earnings in 51 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and DC10 breakout provides solid technical structure, while extreme market fear (26/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 297, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 51 days, negative MACD histogram with weak accumulation, and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk entry into deteriorating conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is solid with price above all major MAs and bullish supertrend, but macro environment is severely deteriorating with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating unfavorable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 51 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and VIX at crisis levels (297) creates compounding event and macro risk that outweighs technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner is bear with high confidence
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 65 positions in Utilities sector with existing NEE position; adding concentration in deteriorating macro environment violates risk management discipline.
